## Checklist

- [ ] The title is in English and follows `<type>(<optional-scope>): <imperative summary>`.
- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated edits or secrets.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior, or the description explains why no test is needed.
- [ ] Documentation and generated artifacts are updated when required.
- [ ] All review feedback is resolved and required CI checks are green before merge.
